parameters.name: AutoOpenDatabase
parameters.description: Specifies whether to automatically start the Oracle instance after restoring a physical backup. Valid values: `true` and `false`.

parameters.name: AutoShutdownDatabase
parameters.description: Specifies whether to automatically stop the Oracle instance before restoring a physical backup. Valid values: `true` and `false`.

parameters.name: BackupGatewayId
parameters.description:
The ID of the backup gateway.

> This parameter is required when **DestinationEndpointInstanceType** is set to `Agent`.

parameters.name: BackupPlanId
parameters.description: The ID of the backup plan.

parameters.name: BackupSetId
parameters.description: The ID of the full backup set to use for the restore. The `BackupSetId` and `RestoreTime` parameters are mutually exclusive.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client-generated token to ensure request idempotence. This token must be unique across requests.

parameters.name: CrossAliyunId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account that owns the source database. This parameter is required for cross-account restores.

parameters.name: CrossRoleName
parameters.description: The name of the RAM role used for the cross-account restore.

parameters.name: DestDatabaseInstanceClass
parameters.description: The instance type of the new instance.> This parameter is required when `RestoreDestinationMode` is set to `NEW_INSTANCE`.

parameters.name: DestDatabaseInstanceDatabaseVersion
parameters.description: The database engine version of the new instance.> This parameter is required when `RestoreDestinationMode` is set to `NEW_INSTANCE`.

parameters.name: DestDatabaseInstanceRegion
parameters.description: The region where the new instance will be created.> This parameter is required when `RestoreDestinationMode` is set to `NEW_INSTANCE`.

parameters.name: DestDatabaseInstanceStorageSize
parameters.description: The storage space of the new instance. Unit: GB.> This parameter is required when `RestoreDestinationMode` is set to `NEW_INSTANCE`.

parameters.name: DestDatabaseInstanceType
parameters.description: The type of the new instance to create for the restore.> This parameter is required when `RestoreDestinationMode` is set to `NEW_INSTANCE`.

parameters.name: DestDatabaseInstanceVSwitch
parameters.description: The vSwitch ID of the new instance.> This parameter is required when `RestoreDestinationMode` is set to `NEW_INSTANCE`.

parameters.name: DestDatabaseInstanceVpc
parameters.description: The VPC ID of the new instance.> This parameter is required when `RestoreDestinationMode` is set to `NEW_INSTANCE`.

parameters.name: DestinationEndpointDatabaseName
parameters.description:
The name of the destination database.

> This parameter is required if the database engine is PostgreSQL or MongoDB.

parameters.name: DestinationEndpointIP
parameters.description:
The endpoint of the destination database.

> This parameter is required when **DestinationEndpointInstanceType** is set to `Express`, `Agent`, or `Other`.

parameters.name: DestinationEndpointInstanceID
parameters.description:
The ID of the destination database instance.

> This parameter is required when **DestinationEndpointInstanceType** is set to `RDS`, `ECS`, `DDS`, or `Express`.

parameters.name: DestinationEndpointInstanceType
parameters.description:
The type of the destination endpoint. Valid values:

- **RDS**: an ApsaraDB RDS instance.

- **ECS**: a self-managed database hosted on an ECS instance.

- **Express**: a database connected over a leased line, VPN Gateway, or Smart Access Gateway.

- **Agent**: a database connected via a backup gateway.

- **DDS**: an ApsaraDB for MongoDB (DDS) instance.

- **Other**: a database connected over the internet by using a public IP address and port.

- **dg**: a self-managed database without a public endpoint, connected via Database Gateway.

parameters.name: DestinationEndpointOracleSID
parameters.description:
The SID of the Oracle database.

> This parameter is required if the database engine is Oracle.

parameters.name: DestinationEndpointPassword
parameters.description:
The password for the destination database account.

> This parameter is optional if the database engine is Redis, or if `DestinationEndpointInstanceType` is set to `Agent` and the database engine is MSSQL. In other scenarios, this parameter is required.

parameters.name: DestinationEndpointPort
parameters.description:
The port that is used to connect to the destination database.

> This parameter is required when **DestinationEndpointInstanceType** is set to `Express`, `Agent`, `Other`, or `ECS`.

parameters.name: DestinationEndpointRegion
parameters.description:
The region ID of the destination database instance.

> This parameter is required when **DestinationEndpointInstanceType** is set to `RDS`, `ECS`, `DDS`, `Express`, or `Agent`.

parameters.name: DestinationEndpointUserName
parameters.description:
The username for the destination database account.

> This parameter is optional if the database engine is Redis, or if `DestinationEndpointInstanceType` is set to `Agent` and the database engine is MSSQL. In other scenarios, this parameter is required.

parameters.name: DuplicateConflict
parameters.description:
The policy for resolving same-name object conflicts. Valid value:

**renamenew**: Renames the restored object if its name conflicts with an existing object.

parameters.name: EnableDestinationEndpointSsl
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable SSL encryption to connect to the destination database.

parameters.name: RestoreDestinationMode
parameters.description:
The type of the restore destination. Valid values:

- **EXIST\_INSTANCE**: Restores data to an existing instance.

- **NEW\_INSTANCE**: Restores data to a new instance.

parameters.name: RestoreDir
parameters.description: The restore directory. This parameter is required if **DestinationEndpointInstanceType** is set to `Agent` and the database type is MySQL.

parameters.name: RestoreHome
parameters.description: The installation directory of the database.

parameters.name: RestoreObjects
parameters.description:
The objects to restore.

- This parameter is optional if `DestinationEndpointInstanceType` is set to `Agent`. In other scenarios, this parameter is required.

- The value must be a JSON string in the following format: `[{ "DBName": "source_database_name", "NewDBName": "destination_database_name" }]`

> You can use this API operation to restore data only at the database level. To restore data at the table level, log on to the console. For more information, see [Restore databases](~~85543~~).

parameters.name: RestoreTaskName
parameters.description: The name of the restore job.

parameters.name: RestoreTime
parameters.description: The point-in-time for the restore, specified as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.

parameters.name: SslCaPem
parameters.description: The SSL certificate used to connect to the destination database.> This parameter is required when `EnableDestinationEndpointSsl` is set to `true`.
